title: Frontier Open-Weight AI Risk Management Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.28082v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight models advance transparency, research, and innovation, and spread the benefits of AI more widely. They also carry distinct risks. A release cannot be undone, safeguards can be removed through fine-tuning, and no single party can monitor use or withdraw the model. Managing these risks therefore requires an approach tailored to open release. This framework addresses the governance challenge at the heart of that choice. Co-developed by Concordia AI and Z.AI, it adapts the full risk management lifecycle, from risk assessment to mitigation and governance, to the unique properties of open-weight models. This document does not resolve every tension between openness and safety. Rather, it provides the first comprehensive, evidence-based foundation for navigating these tensions. As frontier open-weight releases accelerate, risk management best practice and standards are urgently needed. We invite researchers, developers, policymaker

translated_title: 前沿开放权重AI风险管理框架
translated_abstract: 开放权重模型促进了透明度、研究与创新，并使AI的益处得以更广泛地传播，但它们也带来独特的风险：模型发布后无法撤回，安全防护措施可能通过微调被移除，且没有任何单一参与方能够监控其使用或撤回模型。因此，管理这些风险需要一种针对开放发布量身定制的方法。该框架正是针对这一发布方式选择中的核心治理难题而设计。该框架由Concordia AI与Z.AI共同开发，将完整的风险管理生命周期——从风险评估到缓解措施再到治理机制——适配于开放权重模型的独特属性。本文档并不试图解决开放性与安全性之间的所有矛盾，而是为应对这些矛盾提供了首个全面的、基于证据的基础。随着前沿开放权重模型发布的加速，风险管理最佳实践与标准亟待建立。我们邀请研究人员、开发者、政策制定者等各方共同参与（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该框架由Concordia AI与Z.AI共同开发，首次为前沿开放权重AI模型构建了覆盖风险评估、缓解与治理全生命周期的、基于证据的综合风险管理基础。
en_tdlr: Co-developed by Concordia AI and Z.AI, this framework provides the first comprehensive, evidence-based risk management foundation for frontier open-weight AI models by adapting the full risk management lifecycle—from assessment to mitigation and governance—to the unique properties of open release.
